title: Results from City’s Budget Survey!
description:
We asked, you answered! Thank you to more than 13,000 San Diegans who responded to our fiscal year 2027 online budget survey. 


The Proposed Budget for fiscal year 2027 reflects the priorities that San Diegans told us they care most about. This includes public safety, housing, road repair and homelessness services.

Read more: insidesandiego.org/results-citys-budget-survey-show-san-diegans-care-about-streets-and-public-safety
